description: Compare design tokens from the design tool with what the code uses. Pass `design` (W3C design tokens JSON, Tokens Studio JSON, flat key/value JSON, or CSS variables) and `code` (CSS, SCSS or a Tailwind theme with custom properties or hex values). Both are parsed forgivingly. Returns findings grouped by severity with a count summary: design tokens missing from code, code tokens missing from design, same name with a different value (color distance in deltaE, px and rem normalized at 16px), different names with identical values (rename candidates), near-duplicate colors inside the code (deltaE under 2), hard-coded values in code that equal a token exactly, and values that are close to but not exactly a token, naming the token. No AI, nothing stored.

code.description: CSS, SCSS or Tailwind theme text from the codebase.

design.description: Design tokens: W3C or Tokens Studio JSON, flat key/value JSON, or CSS variables.

name: check_design_drift
title: Design drift check
